source_title: MF investor growth slows further as equities falter, launches decline - Business Standard
source_excerpt: The mutual fund (MF) investor growth trajectory remains on the slower side for the second consecutive year, coinciding with the weakness in equity market and a slowdown in new fund launches. The industry has added 4.4 million net new investors in calendar year 2026 (CY26) till September. This is the slowest pace of additions since 2023, when the industry had added 3.7 million investors in the first 9 months.
